items.title: 大模型不再只是生成：智象未来CTO姚霆谈AI如何开始“完成”一个“创作”

excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past year, a clearer trend in the AI industry has emerged: what truly sets leaders apart is no longer just the superior performance of a single model in a specific capability, but rather who can organize "capabilities" into "tasks" and then solidify these "tasks" into a "system." Technologies once discussed separately—text-to-image, image-to-video, video generation, 3D generation, motion generation—are now being reconsidered under a unified question: if future models go beyond answering questions and generating content to understanding complex intentions, mobilizing multiple capabilities, and achieving end-to-end creation, then the core of large model competition will shift from the models themselves to the overall synergy between models, agents, skills, and application scenarios. Consequently, the real divide in the "world model" race may not lie solely in which model better approximates physical laws or replicates the real world, but in who can first build a functional, callable, and commercially viable full-modal production system. Against this backdrop, Yao Ting, co-founder and CTO of Zhixiang Future, offers a forward-looking perspective on "world models," "full modality," and "agent platforms." Rather than merely debating the merits of video generation capabilities, he focuses on how models can evolve from isolated capabilities into creative foundations, how skills can be efficiently, securely managed, orchestrated, and combined, and how applications, in turn, shape the next iteration of models. This elevates the significance of this dialogue beyond discussing the product roadmap of an AI video company to addressing deeper industry shifts.
excerpt_i18n.es: En el último año, un cambio cada vez más claro en la industria de la IA es que lo que realmente marca la diferencia ya no es solo si un modelo tiene una capacidad individual más fuerte, sino quién puede organizar las "capacidades" en "tareas" y luego consolidar esas "tareas" en un "sistema". Módulos tecnológicos como la generación de imágenes a partir de texto, la generación de vídeo a partir de imágenes, la generación de vídeo, la generación 3D y la generación de movimientos, que antes se discutían por separado, ahora se están reconsiderando bajo una misma pregunta: si los modelos futuros no solo responden preguntas y generan contenido, sino que también pueden comprender intenciones complejas, movilizar múltiples capacidades y completar creaciones de extremo a extremo, entonces el núcleo de la competencia entre los grandes modelos cambiará de los modelos en sí hacia los modelos, los agentes, las habilidades y los campos de aplicación.

excerpt_i18n.en: In the days leading up to the Spring Festival, He Jialin's WeChat was constantly buzzing. Financial advisors would send various analytical articles, and investors kept forwarding links to new projects, asking for his thoughts on Openclaw's sudden popularity and how it differed. "That period was genuinely quite anxious," he said. The anxiety didn't stem from competition itself but from a typical entrepreneurial mindset—sometimes he would slap his thigh in frustration, blaming himself for starting a bit late, but after calm analysis, he felt much more at ease. This sentiment was closely tied to what he was working on. He Jialin is the founder of the AI tech company Violoop, which is developing a Chinese version of "hardware lobster," aiming to have AI work for humans 24/7. Specifically, Violoop's solution is a palm-sized desktop hardware device. It physically connects to a computer via a data cable and can directly control both Mac and Windows systems. Unlike traditional software assistants, this device extracts information locally from the computer screen, sends the refined content to a cloud-based large model for reasoning and planning, and finally executes operations on the computer, such as clicking, typing, and switching software. In other words, it not only understands tasks but can also complete them directly for people. On March 12, Violoop announced the completion of tens of millions of yuan in seed and angel round financing, jointly led by a dual-currency fund managing hundreds of billions in USD and RMB, along with a well-known RMB fund. excerpt_i18n.es: Unos días antes del Año Nuevo chino, el WeChat de He Jialin no dejaba de recibir mensajes. Su asesor financiero le enviaba diversos artículos de análisis, y los inversores le reenviaban constantemente enlaces de nuevos proyectos, preguntándole qué opinaba sobre el éxito explosivo de Openclaw y en qué se diferenciaba. "Fue una época de verdadera ansiedad", comentó. Esta ansiedad no provenía de la competencia en sí, sino de una mentalidad típica de emprendedor: a veces se reprochaba por haber empezado un poco tarde, pero tras un análisis sereno, recuperaba la calma. Este estado emocional estaba estrechamente relacionado con lo que estaba haciendo. Recently, HiDream.ai and Noitom Robotics officially announced a strategic partnership. The two parties will engage in deep collaboration on generating high-quality, large-scale embodied intelligence video data, thereby initiating a new model of exploration to broaden the data entry points for the embodied intelligence industry. High-availability training data is currently a bottleneck in the rapidly developing embodied intelligence sector. Unlike large language models that can access vast amounts of text data, embodied intelligence requires the integration of multimodal data such as visual, motion, and tactile information. Traditional data collection methods are costly and inefficient, making synthetic data crucial. As the industry booms, training data is shifting from small-scale demonstrations to large-scale, deliverable volumes, with data acquisition, structuring, and engineering capabilities now determining system performance limits.

Based on this assessment, HiDream.ai and Noitom Robotics are combining the millimeter-level controllable video generation capabilities of multimodal large models with real data infrastructure. By integrating "real data + generative video data," the collaboration is expected to produce tens of thousands of hours of embodied intelligence video data within the year, opening a new path for scalable supply of high-quality embodied training data urgently needed by the industry.

At the ceremony, Dai Ruoli, founder and CEO of Noitom Robotics, and Mei Tao, founder and CEO of HiDream.ai, were present to witness this significant moment.

Noitom Robotics: Building the Data Foundation for Embodied Intelligence  
Noitom Robotics is a data company focused on the embodied intelligence and humanoid robotics industries, with "data" at its core.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, HiDream.ai y Noitom Robotics anunciaron oficialmente una colaboración estratégica. Los datos de entrenamiento altamente utilizables son actualmente un cuello de botella en el rápido desarrollo de la industria de la inteligencia encarnada. A diferencia de los modelos de lenguaje extenso, que pueden obtener grandes cantidades de datos de texto, la inteligencia encarnada requiere la integración de datos multimodales como visión, movimiento y tacto. Los métodos tradicionales de recopilación son costosos y de baja eficiencia, por lo que los datos sintéticos se han convertido en clave. Con el auge de la industria, los datos de entrenamiento están pasando de demostraciones a pequeña escala a volúmenes masivos.

On March 26, 2026, the internationally renowned academic publisher Nature featured Tianli International Holdings Limited (01773.HK) in two in-depth reports within its Nature Index China special issue, systematically presenting the company's exploration in the "AI+Education" field. The special issue was published alongside the main journal and made available on its official website. Structured around technical features and executive interviews, the reports comprehensively depict the exploration of educational AGI within China's K12 education system from three perspectives: philosophy, technological framework, and scale of application. Globally, few cases in basic education have been systematically presented by Nature, and this inclusion signifies that Tianli's AI+Education initiatives have garnered significant attention and recognition from the international academic and educational technology communities.

1. Structural Constraints in Education and the Boundaries of AI Intervention  
Nature's reports point out that traditional education has long been constrained by the tension between "scalable delivery" and "individual differences," rooted in the difficulty of systematically modeling cognitive processes. The evolution of AI is opening new avenues for solutions. Tianli's proposed approach transforms education from a "content delivery problem" into a "cognitive evolution problem." AI is not defined as a replacement for teachers but rather as undertaking structured, repeatable cognitive support tasks, shifting the teaching process from experience-driven to data- and model-driven. Within this framework, education is modeled as a nonlinear system involving individual cognition, learning environments, and strategies, with its evolutionary outcomes manifesting as the formation and updating of cognitive structures.

La edición especial se publicó simultáneamente con la edición principal y se lanzó en el sitio web oficial. Los reportajes, estructurados como perfiles técnicos y entrevistas con altos directivos, desarrollaron una descripción completa de la exploración de la AGI educativa en el sistema educativo chino de K12 desde tres niveles: conceptos, sistema tecnológico y escala de aplicación. En el ámbito de la educación básica global, son pocos los casos que han sido presentados sistemáticamente por Nature, lo que hace que esta selección sea destacable.

items.title: 中山大学梁小丹团队论文：让视频生成从「看起来真实」到「物理上正确」丨CVPR 2026
items.raw_excerpt: 想象这样一些常见却又微妙的场景：一勺蜂蜜缓慢倒入热茶，本应拉出细长连续的丝状流动，但很多生成视频却会突然断裂甚至凭空消失；一块冰在室温下逐渐融化，真实过程应该是边缘先软化、体积变化、最终消散，而生成结果却常常直接从完整变成消失；一个玻璃球落入水中，本应经历接触水面、减速下沉、逐渐稳定的过程，但模型却可能只给出一个结果画面。 这些现象并不罕见，也正是当前视频生成技术最容易让人出戏的地方。画面看起来像，但过程不对，缺乏因果关系，也缺乏真实世界中那种连续演化的逻辑。 随着视频生成模型的发展，从 OpenAI Sora 到 Kling 等系统不断刷新视觉质量的上限，行业已经基本解决了清晰度和风格的问题，却逐渐暴露出更深层的瓶颈，即模型缺乏对物理规律的理解能力。 现有方法更多依赖数据驱动的模式匹配，本质上是在生成看起来合理的结果，而不是在模拟真实发生的过程，这也导致在流体、热变化以及多物体交互等场景中表现明显不足。 在这样的背景下，来自四川大学的雷印杰团队提出了一项新的研究工作《Chain of Event-Centric Causal Thought for Physically Plausible Video Generation》。这项研究不再直接从文本生成视频，而是尝试让模型先理解物理过程本身，将复杂现象拆分为一系列具有因果关系的事件，并结合物理规律进行约束，再逐步生成视频内容。 通过这种方式，目标不再只是让画面看起来真实，而是让变化过程本身也符合现实世界的运行逻辑，从而在更深层次上提升视频生成的可信度和一致性。 论文地址：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.09094 更加符合「真实世界」的方式 在实验结果方面，研究团队首先在 PhyGenBench 数据集上进行了系统评估。这个数据集包含 160 条物理描述，覆盖力学、光学、热学和材料四类典型物理场景。

Imagine some common yet subtle scenarios: a spoonful of honey slowly poured into hot tea should form a long, continuous thread-like flow, but many generated videos show it suddenly breaking or even disappearing out of thin air; an ice cube gradually melting at room temperature should first soften at the edges, change in volume, and eventually dissipate, yet generated results often shift directly from intact to vanished; a glass ball falling into water should undergo the process of touching the surface, slowing down as it sinks, and gradually stabilizing, but models might only produce a single outcome frame. These phenomena are not uncommon and are precisely where current video generation technology most easily breaks immersion. The visuals may look similar, but the process is off, lacking causality and the logical continuity of evolution found in the real world.

Current methods rely more on data-driven pattern matching, essentially generating results that appear plausible rather than simulating real-world processes. excerpt_i18n.en:
Waking up at 3 a.m. may be the most relatable anxiety scenario for contemporary professionals. We try to retrieve the flash of insight from a dinner two hours earlier, only grasping a few vague words—supply chain? Downward market? Neuroscience research shows that without external reinforcement within 30 seconds of an idea's emergence, the loss rate of details can be as high as 70%. However, the real challenge lies not in memory but in the act of recording itself. In business settings—toasting, shaking hands, driving, or networking at exhibitions—"pulling out a phone" is the ultimate social taboo and operational barrier. Countless ideas spark daily in coffee chats and brainstorming sessions, only to be lost on the "path to operational tools."  

The current AI Agent market presents an interesting paradox: the more powerful the technology, the higher the usability barrier. Conversational agents require you to stay by a screen; wearables either listen indiscriminately (a privacy nightmare) or have complex activation processes (an operational burden). Users possess the most powerful AI yet miss opportunities precisely when they need it most, simply because "activating it" is cumbersome.  

"Workplace efficiency has never been built on transcribing text. What we truly need is the ability to execute ideas the moment they are spoken." This is the foundation of Gyges Labs' creation of the Vocci Ring—the world's first AI note-taking ring, offering the shortest path to AI Agent interaction.
excerpt_i18n.es: Despertarse sobresaltado a las tres de la madrugada podría ser la escena de ansiedad más compartida entre los profesionales contemporáneos. Intentamos rescatar en nuestra mente esa chispa de inspiración que surgió durante la cena de negocios dos horas antes, pero solo logramos atrapar unas cuantas palabras difusas: ¿cadena de suministro? ¿mercado de bajos ingresos? La investigación en neurociencia muestra que, si no se consolida externamente en los primeros 30 segundos después de surgir, la tasa de pérdida de detalles de una idea alcanza el 70%. Sin embargo, la verdadera dificultad no radica en la memoria, sino en el acto mismo de registrar. Cuando te encuentras en un entorno empresarial —brindando, estrechando manos, conduciendo, intercambiando saludos en ferias— "sacar el teléfono" se convierte en el mayor tabú social y barrera operativa. A diario, generamos innumerables ideas en conversaciones de café o lluvias de ideas, pero las vemos desvanecerse ante nuestros ojos.

excerpt_i18n.en: As the AI industry shifts from competition in model capabilities to large-scale application deployment, systematic optimization around "Token inference efficiency" has become a core industry focus. With the explosive growth of applications such as intelligent agents and AI coding, Token consumption has surged by hundreds or even thousands of times, making 2026 the true "Year of Token Explosion." The industry's primary concern is transitioning from model parameter scale and usability to stable, low-cost, high-quality Token production capacity, stated Academician Zheng Weimin. However, domestic computing power utilization is mired in structural challenges. First, there is a severe imbalance in resource allocation, with Token generation overly reliant on GPUs, while expensive resources like high-end memory, cluster SSDs, and InfiniBand interconnects see less than 10% utilization, and overall machine utilization remains below 20%, leading to massive wasteful spending on intelligent computing. Additionally, hardware-software coordination falls short; despite continuous hardware advancements, software optimization and distributed parallel stability are insufficient, wasting over 80% of theoretical computing power, with inefficient scheduling further incurring hidden losses exceeding 50%. excerpt_i18n.es: A medida que la industria de la IA pasa de competir en capacidades de modelos a competir en aplicaciones a gran escala, la optimización sistemática en torno a la "eficiencia de inferencia de tokens" se convierte en el núcleo del sector. Con el crecimiento explosivo de aplicaciones como agentes inteligentes y codificación con IA, el consumo de tokens ha aumentado cientos o miles de veces, haciendo de 2026 el auténtico "año de la explosión de tokens". El enfoque principal de la industria de la IA está cambiando completamente desde la escala de parámetros del modelo y su usabilidad hacia la capacidad de producción de tokens estable, de bajo costo y alta calidad, según afirmó el académico Zheng Weimin. Sin embargo, al mismo tiempo, la utilización de la capacidad computacional en el país se encuentra sumida en un dilema estructural. En primer lugar, la proporción de recursos está gravemente desequilibrada.

excerpt_i18n.en: On March 28, 2026, the "Fengyun G Summit—Marketing, Technology, and Compliance Governance Forum" was successfully held at the Xuhui Riverside West Bund International Exhibition Center. Supported by the Shanghai Advertising Association and the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Industry Association, the forum brought together over 200 industry elites, regulatory representatives, and media professionals. It facilitated in-depth exchanges and intellectual collisions around three core topics in the GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) industry: marketing practices, technological innovation, and compliance governance, injecting new momentum into the industry's standardization and high-quality development.   The expert team from Analysys released the "Post-315 Era GEO Industry Development—Competitiveness Analysis of China's GEO Industry and GEO Enterprise Forum Keynote Report." Supported by data and case studies, the report comprehensively analyzed the market status, industry ecosystem, typical enterprise cases, and development trends of the GEO industry in the "post-315 era," providing directional guidance for industry practices. As a core promoter of industry standardization, an expert from the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology delivered a keynote speech titled "Trustworthy GEO: A Preliminary Exploration of High-Quality Data and Algorithm Collaboration in the Intelligent Economy Era." Focusing on the challenges of data and algorithm collaboration in building trustworthy GEO, the speech deeply dissected the key points, framework, and implementation pathways for GEO industry standard formulation, proposing ideas for establishing and improving industry standards. Technological innovation is the driving force behind the development of the GEO industry, while trustworthiness serves as its bottom line. excerpt_i18n.es: El 28 de marzo de 2026, el Foro "Fengyun G - Marketing, Tecnología y Gobernanza de Cumplimiento" se celebró con éxito en el Centro Internacional de Exposiciones de la Zona Oeste del Río Xuhui. Con el apoyo de la Asociación de Publicidad de Shanghái y la Asociación de Industria de Inteligencia Artificial de Shanghái, este foro reunió a más de 200 élites de la industria, representantes de organismos reguladores y profesionales de los medios. Se centró en tres temas clave del sector GEO (Optimización de Motores Generativos): prácticas de marketing, innovación tecnológica y gobernanza de cumplimiento, promoviendo un intercambio profundo y un choque de ideas que inyectó un nuevo impulso para la estandarización y el desarrollo de alta calidad de la industria.
